name: emw-warp-otf
label: Warp - OTF Preprocessing
help:
Warp wrapper to run motion correction, CTF estimation, tilt-series alignment, and tomogram reconstruction in on-the-fly (OTF) mode. It combines the following programs:

*Motion correction and CTF*:
[[https://warpem.github.io/warp/reference/warptools/api/frame_series/?h=fs_motion_and_ctf][fs_motion_and_ctf]]

*AreTomo alignment*:
[[https://warpem.github.io/warp/reference/warptools/api/tilt_series/?h=ts_aretomo#ts_aretomo][ts_aretomo]]

*CTF and reconstruction*:
[[https://warpem.github.io/warp/reference/warptools/api/tilt_series/?h=ts_ctf#ts_ctf][ts_ctf]]
[[https://warpem.github.io/warp/reference/warptools/api/tilt_series/?h=ts_reconstruct#ts_reconstruct][ts_reconstruct]]

params.name: input_tiltseries
params.label: Input tilt series:
params.help: STAR file with input tilt-series

params.name: fs_motion_and_ctf.m_range_min
params.label: min
params.help: (--m_range_min) Default: 500. Minimum resolution in Angstrom to consider in fit

params.name: fs_motion_and_ctf.m_range_max
params.label: max
params.help: (--m_range_max) Default: 10. Maximum resolution in Angstrom to consider in fit

params.name: fs_motion_and_ctf.m_bfac
params.label: Bfactor (Aˆ2)
params.help: (--m_bfac)  Default: -500. Downweight higher spatial frequencies using a B-factor, in Angstrom^2

params.name: fs_motion_and_ctf.m_grid
params.label: Grid (XxYxN):
params.help: (--m_grid) Default: 5x5xN. Resolution of the motion model grid in X, Y, and temporal dimensions, separated by 'x': e.g. 5x5x40; empty = auto

params.name: extra_create_settings
params.label: create_settings extra arguments
params.help:
Extra arguments to pass to create_settings.

--bin_angpix: Choose the binning exponent automatically to match this target pixel size in Angstrom. 0 = No binning, 1 = Bin 2x, etc.

--eer_ngroups: Default: 40. Number of groups to combine raw EER frames into, i.e. number of 'virtual' frames in resulting stack; use negative value to specify the number of frames per virtual frame instead.

params.name: fs_motion_and_ctf.c_range_min
params.label: min
params.help: (--c_range_min: Minimum resolution in Angstrom to consider in fit. Default: 500.

params.name: fs_motion_and_ctf.c_range_max
params.label: max
params.help: (--c_range_max: Maximum resolution in Angstrom to consider in fit. Default: 10.

params.name: fs_motion_and_ctf.c_defocus_min
params.label: min
params.help: (--c_defocus_min: Minimum resolution in Angstrom to consider in fit. Default: 500.

params.name: fs_motion_and_ctf.c_defocus_max
params.label: max
params.help: (--c_defocus_max: Maximum resolution in Angstrom to consider in fit. Default: 10.

params.name: fs_motion_and_ctf.c_window
params.label: Window (px)
params.help: (--c_window: Patch size for CTF estimation in binned pixels. Default: 512.

params.name: fs_motion_and_ctf.c_grid
params.label: Grid (XxYxN):
params.help: (--c_grid) Resolution of the defocus model grid in X, Y, and temporal dimensions, separated by 'x': e.g. 2x2x1; empty = auto; Z > 1 is purely experimental

params.name: fs_motion_and_ctf.c_use_sum
params.label: Use sum
params.help: (--c_use_sum) Use the movie average spectrum instead of the average of individual frames' spectra. Can help in the absence of an energy filter, or when signal is low.

params.name: fs_motion_and_ctf.out_average_halves
params.label: Output averages halves
params.help: --out_average_halves: Export aligned averages of odd and even frames separately, e.g. for denoiser training.

params.name: extra_ts_import
params.label: ts_import extra arguments
params.help:
Extra arguments to pass to ts_import. For example:
--min_ntilts       Default: 1. Only import tilt series that have at least this many tilts after all the other filters have been applied.

params.name: ts_aretomo.angpix
params.label: Output pixel size (A/pix)
params.help: Rescale tilt images to this pixel size; normally 10–15 A for cryo data; leave out to keep the original pixel size.

params.name: ts_aretomo.axis_iter
params.label: Iter
params.help: Default: 0. Number of tilt axis angle refinement iterations; each iteration will be started with median value from previous iteration, final iteration will use fixed angle.

params.name: ts_aretomo.axis_batch
params.label: Batch
params.help: Default: 0. Use only this many tilt series for the tilt axis angle search; only relevant if --axis_iter isn't 0.

params.name: ts_aretomo.patches
params.label: Patches
params.help: Number of patches for local alignments in X, Y, separated by 'x': e.g. 6x4. Increases processing time.

params.name: ts_reconstruct.halfmap_frames
params.label: Output half-tomograms from frames
params.help: Also produce two half-tomograms, each reconstructed from half of the frames (requires running align_frameseries with --average_halves previously)

params.name: gpus
params.label: GPUs
params.help: If it is a single number (N), it will represent the total number of GPUs (0..N-1). It there are multiple values, it will be the specific GPUs ID.

params.name: perdevice
params.label: Processes per device
params.help: (--per_device in fs_motion_and_ctf, ts_reconstruct)

params.label: Launchers
params.help: Launchers to use for the different programs

params.name: launcher_warp
params.label: WARP
params.help: Launcher to use for Warp

params.name: launcher_aretomo
params.label: ARETOMO
params.help: Launcher to use for Aretomo
